spec.scope: This project involves developing a simple REST API for managing personal notes. The system will allow users to create a note, retrieve a list of all notes, and delete a specific note by its id. The backend will be built using Node.js and Express, with in-memory storage for the notes data. No authentication or frontend components are required.

decisions.decision: Use in-memory storage for notes data
decisions.rationale: The requirement specifies transient data without persistence. In-memory storage is simple and fits personal use cases.

decisions.decision: Define a sequential id scheme starting at 1 for notes
decisions.rationale: The design specifies a sequential integer id starting at 1 to uniquely identify each note.

decisions.decision: Implement API endpoints at the root path without prefixes
decisions.rationale: This is consistent with the design, which does not specify any versioning or api prefix.

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /notes creates a note with fields title and body, assigns a server-generated sequential integer id starting at 1, and returns a JSON response with the created note including id, title, and body.
GET /notes retrieves all stored notes, returning a JSON array of notes with each note containing id, title, and body.
DELETE /notes/:id removes the note with the specified id from storage and returns a 404 JSON error response if the note does not exist.

files_to_create.purpose: Sets up the Express server, mounts all routes, and listens on a specified port.
Implements business logic for creating, listing, and deleting notes.
Manages storage and retrieval of notes data in memory.
